task: ae.heap: slotted-page record heap with CRC32 and atomic flush
reasoning_summary: Designed a slotted page (directory growing up, records growing down, trailing CRC32) and a heap file of such pages with a checksummed header. Tests were written first, including per-byte flip detection, crafted overlapping slots with valid CRC, and randomized model checks. Updates that cannot fit fail without mutating the page. All 24 tests passed on the first run.
